name: – Anna Strolenberg – After § 4 – Am 40
title: REPORT on the situation of fundamental rights in the European Union in 2024 and 2025
part_text: 4a. Underlines that parents or legal guardians have the primary responsibility for the upbringing and development of their children, particularly regarding sensitive areas such as sexuality and relationships education; emphasises the importance of ensuring the right of parents to be fully informed, and to exercise an informed choice, regarding the participation of their children in such programmes, in full respect of the competences of the Member States in the field of education;
